name: the death of winter
source:
Suzu holds a lantern with his best friend's soul inside it. He talks to her on the night before he becomes a legend.

[From [url=https://swanchime.itch.io/the-death-of-winter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
铃拿着一盏灯笼，里面有他最好朋友的灵魂。他在成为传奇的前一天晚上与她交谈。

[来自[url=https://swanchime.itch.io/the-death-of-winter]itch.io[/url]]
